items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Just one time, I think that I can remember, when Walter Barnes did the job in the place where they were burned.

ctx.x: But when you got extra work, suppose you got two jobs in the same night, would you give to somebody you knew? I don't know.

Unfortunately, that never happened too often. Just one time, I think that I can remember, when Walter Barnes did the job in the place where they were burned. I ran in Natchez. Well, I was supposed to play that job. But instead I was playing in another little town. I can't call the name of the town, it was about a hundred miles from that. So I couldn't get to that job. So maybe, might have been for the better. I remember the place. I remember it vividly. And I was going to that same dance hall, freezing in the…
Yeah. Well, you just took that for granted. Right. When I have those old stoves. Right.
